_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
"The container" is the messages container (".messages-container"), "the button" the scroll-to-bottom button (".scroll-to-bottom-button"), and "the gap" the container's scrollHeight - clientHeight - scrollTop. To "send" a message, fill the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) with it and click the send button ([data-testid="send-button"]). Check every assertion with an eval that has "expect" (or an assert_* or wait_* step): an eval without "expect" asserts nothing. When a step says to record something, do it in one eval without "expect" that stores it in the named window variable, then check that variable. Perform the steps in order. The test seeds a long conversation with ID {{ID}}; to "open the conversation", navigate to /c/{{ID}}, wait for the message input ([data-testid="message-input"]) to be visible (allow 30s), then wait for the first [data-testid="message"] element to be visible (allow 30s). "Scroll up" means: eval setting the container's scrollTop to 0; the button should become visible (allow 10s). "Still up" means: record the container's scrollTop in window.__top, then window.__top < 50 must be true. Focus matters here: press keys with press_key steps alone, and add no clicks the steps do not ask for. Cmd/Ctrl+ArrowDown scrolls to the bottom after switching conversations in the drawer. The test also seeds a second long conversation, {{SECOND}}.
1. Open the conversation.
2. Click ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"{{SECOND}}\"]" in the drawer. The first conversation's messages stay mounted briefly during the switch, and the second's own load-time autoscroll could land after the manual scroll below, so wait until new RegExp("/c/[^/]*{{SECOND}}").test(location.href) is true (allow 30s), then for the first [data-testid="message"] to be visible (allow 30s).
3. The precondition the fix hinges on: focus is in the composer, not the list. Wait until document.activeElement?.tagName is exactly "TEXTAREA" (allow 10s).
4. In one eval on the container: dispatch new WheelEvent("wheel", {deltaY: -200, bubbles: true}), then set scrollTop to 0. The button should become visible (allow 10s).
5. Press ArrowDown with the Control modifier.
6. Wait until the gap <= 2 is true (allow 10s). The button must not be visible (allow 10s).

steps.expression: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.messages-container'); c.dispatchEvent(new WheelEvent('wheel', {deltaY: -200, bubbles: true})); c.scrollTop = 0; })()
(() => { const c = document.querySelector('.messages-container'); return c.scrollHeight - c.clientHeight - c.scrollTop <= 2; })()
